sentences.japanese: 最も力の強い種や、最も知能の高い種が生き残るのではなく、変化に最も良く適応できる種が生き残るのです。
sentences.english: It is not the strongest of the species that survives, not the most intelligent, but the one most responsive to change.

sentences.japanese: 君はこの種の音楽が好きになるだろう。
sentences.english: You will come to like this kind of music.

sentences.japanese: 君はいつも頭痛の種だ。
sentences.english: You are always the cause of my worries.

sentences.japanese: お前はいつも私の心配の種だよ。
sentences.english: You are always the cause of my worries.

sentences.japanese: 君はいつか自分でまいた種を刈り取らなければならないだろう。
sentences.english: Some day you will have to reap the harvest of your own sowing.
